notes:
ARKhives 8.19.14

- Repair native notebook source-link navigation and timestamp insertion beside an existing link.
- Style new linked selections as editable bold red headings with a soft tinted background; timestamp badges remain secondary.
- Clear stale notebook page painting on zoom, resize and display-scale changes.
- Avoid redundant native zoom, ribbon and focus redraws; reduce repeated progress-label updates.
- Open the embedded office archive without making a second copy of its roughly 188 MiB compressed payload.
- Reuse the document converter through short study pauses, releasing it after three idle minutes or when its editor closes.
- Space automatic DOCX exports to 15 seconds of idle time with a 60-second continuous-edit checkpoint. Explicit saves and navigation continue to save immediately.
- Enlarge and center the animated ARKhives video loading logo, including its visible SVG rather than just its wrapper.
- Add a visible Chapter action beside lesson navigation and an option to create a chapter from selected notebook text.
- Preserve independent mobile presentation and the coordinated learning/sync contract.

Local notebooks, question banks, recording files and study progress are retained. Existing hand-formatted notebook links are not bulk reformatted.
